name: Greyline Bazaar
worldBackground: Greyline Bazaar is a drowned quarter of the sprawl where the rain never stops and the neon never dims. Noodle steam, ozone and street-fryer smoke blur together under canopy strung between apartment pillars. The tension: the Mercy+ clinic and the back-alley ripperdoc compete for the same desperate patients, and the market lives or dies on which one the syndicates let stay open.

setting.technology: cyberpunk: neural implants, holographic signage, cheap automation, failing municipal power
setting.climate: perpetual heavy rain, warm and humid, frequent thunder

templates.name: Wok fry station
templates.description: A dual-flame wok range where synth-broth and flash-fried noodles hit the steel in seconds.
templates.physicalDescription: Two blackened wok bowls set into a scarred steel range with gas lines and hanging ladles.
templates.rule: One wok station against the back wall of each noodle bar, behind the serving counter, never beside the door where rain gusts in.

templates.name: Tin serving counter
templates.description: A dented counter where bowl after bowl slides across to hungry market workers.
templates.physicalDescription: A long grey steel slab with stacked bowls, chopstick cups and a chipped till at one end.
templates.rule: Runs parallel to the doorway with stools lined along the customer side; staff work in the gap behind it.

templates.name: Plastic stool
templates.description: A stackable stool, cracked and taped, the standard seat of the drowned quarter.
templates.physicalDescription: A small bright square of moulded plastic with a faint ring of dried broth on top.
templates.rule: Cluster stools around bistro tables and in rows facing counters; never in the doorway path.

templates.name: Chipped bistro table
templates.description: A small table for noodles, deals and courier rumours under the Leaky Amp's speakers.
templates.physicalDescription: A scratched alloy tabletop ringed with cup stains and the burnt glow of a holo coaster.
templates.rule: Fill the Leaky Amp's common room with scattered tables, one or two stools at each long side, clear of the stair.

templates.name: Wire shelving rack
templates.description: Bolted wire racks holding ration packs, chems or implant parts depending on the door.
templates.physicalDescription: An open grid frame of shelves with boxes, bottles and bins stacked in tidy rows.
templates.rule: Push racks against the back walls of shops, pharmacies and store rooms, leaving one clear cell in front for browsing.

templates.name: Med-fridge
templates.description: A humming pharmaceutical chiller whose stock decides who lives through the night.
templates.physicalDescription: A white cube with a heavy latch, frost on the seams and a glowing inventory strip down one edge.
templates.rule: Place behind a counter or in a corner of any clinic or pharmacy, plugged against a wall and above flood line.

templates.name: Reception terminal desk
templates.description: A desk with a cracked terminal that runs triage lists, tabs and stall licences.
templates.physicalDescription: An L of grey laminate with a flickering holo-terminal, cable runs and a card reader.
templates.rule: Face one desk toward Mercy+'s entrance as reception, or tuck another into a shop corner as a till.

templates.name: Trauma gurney
templates.description: A padded trauma bed where patients ride out the worst the quarter inflicts.
templates.physicalDescription: A narrow padded bed on a scuffed pedestal with a monitor arm and blood-taped rails at the head.
templates.rule: Row gurneys along Mercy+'s trauma bay wall a cell apart, each beside its monitor, never under a leaking canopy seam.

templates.name: Ripperdoc surgical chair
templates.description: A reclined operation chair with clamps for wrists, ankles and worse.
templates.physicalDescription: A chrome recliner ringed by tool trays, hanging cables and a surgical lamp arm.
templates.rule: Set a single surgical chair in the curtained heart of The Backdoor, facing away from the door, tool tray within one cell.

templates.name: Hotplate kitchenette
templates.description: A single burner, a dented kettle and a lifetime of instant noodles in every micro-apartment.
templates.physicalDescription: A scorched burner disc on a crate with a taped power lead and a hanging water pouch.
templates.rule: One per micro-apartment, tucked in a corner against the back wall and a full cell clear of any bedding.

templates.name: Pipe bunk bed
templates.description: A two-tier pipe frame with thin mattresses, home for Pillar Stack shift workers.
templates.physicalDescription: A metal frame with a mattress on the top tier, bedding balled at one end and clothes hung off the rail.
templates.rule: Bunks against the interior wall farthest from the door, one frame per sleeper, head to the wall.

templates.name: Foam floor pallet
templates.description: A scavenged foam mat and thermal blanket that passes for a bed in the Annex.
templates.physicalDescription: A thin flat pad with a crumpled foil blanket and a folded jacket for a pillow.
templates.rule: Pallets in Squatters' Annex rooms wherever the floor stays dry, clear of the door swing and the weeping walls.

templates.name: Taped supply crate
templates.description: A resin crate of ration packs, parts or contraband, lid strapped against the rain.
templates.physicalDescription: A square faded-orange crate with silver tape sealing the seams and stencilled codes on the lid.
templates.rule: Stack crates in store rooms and behind stalls; outdoors scatter them beside building walls, never on the drainage channel.

templates.name: Water filtration rig
templates.description: Pumps and filter drums that turn tank sludge into drinkable water for two towers.
templates.physicalDescription: A squat bank of pumps, transparent filter cylinders and gurgling pipe runs along one face.
templates.rule: Only inside the Reclaimer Shed, bolted along the wall nearest the tank feed pipes.

templates.name: Rain-slick stairwell
templates.description: A grated switchback stair, wet forever, linking the quarter's storeys.
templates.physicalDescription: A square outline of open grate treads and a rusted handrail seen from directly above.
templates.rule: One stairwell in every multi-storey building — Leaky Amp, both Pillar towers, the Annex — against a wall away from the main entrance.

templates.name: Hawker stall
templates.description: A tarp-roofed stall of fried skewers, bootleg chips or umbrellas, open till the water rises.
templates.physicalDescription: A bright tarp canopy over a counter cart, side flaps rolled up and guy-cords lashed to neighbouring frames.
templates.rule: Rows of stalls flank the Rainmarket Strip path on both sides, backs to the building lines, never touching the drainage channel.

templates.name: Steam vent
templates.description: A paving grate where the towers' excess heat blasts steam into the strip's eternal drizzle.
templates.physicalDescription: A rusted grate square in the paving, edges stained orange, faint steam haze drifting across it.
templates.rule: Set vents in the strip's paving between stall rows, one step off the walking line and never beside seating.

templates.name: Neon signboard
templates.description: A humming vertical signboard advertising broth, implants or chems through the rain.
templates.physicalDescription: A slim glowing panel in hot pink and cyan, its light streaking down the wet facade beneath.
templates.rule: Mount signboards against building fronts above each doorway, one per face, never flat where floodwater laps.

templates.name: Drainage channel
templates.description: An open gutter down the strip's spine that swallows the evening flood, badly.
templates.physicalDescription: A long grate-lined trough of running water with silt bars along its edges.
templates.rule: Run channels along the centre of the Rainmarket Strip and past shop frontage as straight stretches that stalls and benches never overlap.

templates.name: Umbrella rack
templates.description: A drum of borrowed umbrellas at every threshold, honesty enforced by the rain.
templates.physicalDescription: A round bin bristling with folded umbrella handles, a shallow rust ring spreading at its base.
templates.rule: One rack just inside or beside every shop and clinic doorway, drip side toward the drain.

templates.name: Triage awning
templates.description: A clear-plastic canopy where Chrome Row's wounded queue out of the rain.
templates.physicalDescription: A translucent sloped canopy on four poles over folding trestles, tape arrows marking the floor.
templates.rule: One awning spilling from Mercy+'s entrance onto Chrome Row, clear of the drainage line and the beacon cable.

templates.name: Waiting bench
templates.description: A slat bench bolted down so queue-jumpers can't rearrange the furniture.
templates.physicalDescription: A straight two-cell bench of ribbed plastic slats on lightly rusted steel legs.
templates.rule: Line benches facing the gurneys in Mercy+'s waiting bay, and set paired benches along Chrome Row and the Pillar court paths.

templates.name: Emergency beacon
templates.description: A strobing trauma beacon that summons medi-drones through the thunder.
templates.physicalDescription: A slender pole crowned with an amber strobe halo, cabling stapled down its length.
templates.rule: A single beacon at Chrome Row's midpoint beside the triage awning, kept clear of stalls and signboards.

templates.name: Bin cluster
templates.description: Wheelie bins for broth cartons, blood bags and things that shouldn't be binned.
templates.physicalDescription: A tight knot of three dented bins with weighted lids, slick runoff pooling around their feet.
templates.rule: Cluster bins beside service doors and behind stall rows, always downhill of any food counter.

templates.name: Laundry line
templates.description: Lines slung court-wide, drip-drying the towers' clothes into air that never dries them.
templates.physicalDescription: Criss-crossed cords overhead strung with shirts and sheeting, pegs and sagging loops visible from above.
templates.rule: String lines across the Pillar Stacks service court between tower walls, spanning above head height and never over the transit shelter.

templates.name: Transit shelter
templates.description: A half-roofed shelter where shift workers queue for trams that may or may not run.
templates.physicalDescription: An open-backed frame with a curved translucent roof, a route holo-panel and standing room inside.
templates.rule: One shelter beside the path at the court's tram stop, opening away from the driving rain.

templates.name: Reclamation tank
templates.description: The court's cistern, catching roof runoff the pumps will fight all night to make potable.
templates.physicalDescription: A squat ribbed cylinder with a dished top, inlet pipes from tower downspouts and a moss skirt at its base.
templates.rule: Place one tank in the service court directly beside the Reclaimer Shed with feed pipes running shed-ward.

templates.name: Channel fern
templates.description: Tough ferns crowding every crack the runoff keeps wet, the quarter's only green.
templates.physicalDescription: A bright tuft of fronds bursting from pavement seams, leaflets slick with rain.
templates.rule: Scatter ferns along wall bases, tank feet and channel edges where runoff gathers, never in doorways or on paths.

templates.name: Collapse rubble
templates.description: A slab of fallen parapet furred with moss, as much landmark as obstruction down here.
templates.physicalDescription: A jagged patch of broken concrete and rebar with puddles pooled in its hollows.
templates.rule: Pile rubble against pillar footings and lot corners, clear of every door, path and drainage run.

templates.name: Filament strip light
templates.description: A scavenged filament tube that browns out with the grid and buzzes back with the thunder.
templates.physicalDescription: A thin bright bar caged in tape and wire, rain-haze haloing its glow from above.
templates.rule: Mount one strip above every bunk row, counter and surgical chair; outdoors only under awnings or stall roofs, never exposed to the storm.

npcs.name: Wen Zhao-Yi
npcs.description: She works six counter stools from dawn to flood and wants enough saved by storm season to replace her two failing broth boilers before they die.
npcs.physicalDescription: Short and thick-armed, in an oil-spattered apron over a yellow rain slicker; her left hand is a cheap cargo-model prosthetic with a ladle socket welded into the palm.

npcs.name: Dex Amaro
npcs.description: He fries noodles till the 4 a.m. rush and wants to buy Wok Nine's deed from its absent owner before the syndicates claim the empty unit; he worries about the stim-tea debt he owes a collector who never stops smiling.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall and wiry in a grease-stained bomber jacket; three jade studs run up his right ear, one for each year he has squatted Pillar 13.

npcs.name: Marisol Ocampo
npcs.description: She keeps her nine-table common room loud on a forty-year-old sound rig and wants the rooftop antenna raised before thunder season shreds her signal; she fears every brownout could be the one that kills her amp wall for good.
npcs.physicalDescription: Broad-shouldered with a buzzed silver scalp, wearing patched courier leathers; a grey-market hearing implant whistles faintly whenever thunder rolls.

npcs.name: Elias Osei
npcs.description: He counts his two hundred ration packs twice a day and wants a wholesale battery shipment to beat the winter run; he worries about looters the moment the strip floods ankle-deep and the hawker cameras go dark.
npcs.physicalDescription: Paunchy and deliberate, in a shopkeeper's tabard with two dozen pockets; an old wooden wrist abacus clicks on his left arm.

npcs.name: Anika Roy
npcs.description: She treats forty-odd patients a week in a licensed trauma bay and wants to buy a backup generator before storm grid failures hit triage; she worries the syndicates will one day order her shutters down the way they did Chrome Row's last clinic.
npcs.physicalDescription: Lean and upright, surgical greens under a grey coat; a faint row of three self-done stitch scars marks her own jaw.

npcs.name: Ozzie Malveaux
npcs.description: He cuts implants behind a curtain by the light of one salvaged surgical lamp and wants enough syndicate credit to buy a real autoclave; he worries about the septic failures he hears about from patients Mercy+ turned away and never saw again.
npcs.physicalDescription: Narrow and stooped, rubber apron over a cracked vest; his right eye is a mismatched amber lens that ticks when he focuses.

npcs.name: Mao Kesorn
npcs.description: She guards a shelf of forty antibiotic vials like currency and wants a working cold-storage unit before the humidity spoils the batch; she worries the counterfeit chems moving through the strip will poison her regulars and get blamed on her.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tiny and ramrod straight, reading goggles pushed up into a white bun; she smells permanently of menthol rub.

npcs.name: Tata Ilunga
npcs.description: She keeps the pumps that make the towers' water drinkable and is down to her last two filter membranes; she wants spares ordered before the next lightning strike and lies awake fearing the brownout that lets fouled water through to two hundred taps.
npcs.physicalDescription: Stocky, in a waterproof coverall with sleeves rolled past blue-stained knuckles from membrane sealant.

player.name: Cass Oduya
player.description: A long-haul courier stranded when the rain season flooded the maglev lines, she runs parcels along the strip for the market stalls and wants to bank enough for a berth on the first barge out; she worries her transit visa expires before the water drops.
player.physicalDescription: Long-legged and rain-pale under a chrome-yellow poncho; a cracked courier drone with a frayed strap rides her left shoulder like a pet.
